recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-33072. Handle any future Specimen.collection.bodySite rename, binding-name update, search-parameter rename, or cardinality change under FHIR-54843 or a later applied successor.
issue_request: FHIR-33072 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested changing Specimen.collection.bodySite from only CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(BodyStructure).
initial_application: The Jira comments identify the FHIR-33072 application as PR #1393 merge a87c89188409cb507ce735de0c269fb3129fa6b3, correcting an earlier mistaken reference to 7ca1165. The underlying source commit 24781f034775f1c0671511079638086eb9713194 changed the StructureDefinition datatype to CodeableReference with BodyStructure target, updated the example to use CodeableReference.concept, and the merge changed the bodysite search parameter to reference on Specimen.collection.bodySite.reference.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml still has Specimen.collection.bodySite as CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure with the body-site binding. The current bodysite search parameter is reference-based. Confluence OO minutes confirm the 2021 vote and rationale. Later FHIR-53203 bodyStructure adoption was checked and is already represented separately on the combined branch; later FHIR-54843 proposes renaming Specimen.collection.bodySite to bodyStructure and making it repeating, but it remains Resolved - change required/Ready_to_Apply and is outside this seed's Applied/Published source-edit scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source and combined branch already satisfy the FHIR-33072 datatype request. Applying the later FHIR-54843 rename/cardinality change under this issue would overreach the seed decision.

related_jiras.note: The ServiceRequest parameters issue prompted the bodySite CodeableReference alignment discussion but is a separate ServiceRequest decision.
A later Applied OO bodyStructure adoption issue was checked; it is already represented separately on the combined branch and does not make FHIR-33072 incomplete.

A later Resolved - change required issue proposes renaming Specimen.collection.bodySite to bodyStructure and changing cardinality, but it is not Applied/Published and remains outside this seed's edit scope.
